t: This is Camberwell Green, about a hectare of common land laid out as a formal park. It sits at the junction of Camberwell Road, Denmark Hill, Camberwell New Road and Camberwell Church Street. Shops, banks and restaurants overlook it from the south-west. It was once common land of the manor, with grazing rights for local residents, and the parish vestry bought it in the late nineteenth century to protect it from development. The writer Angus Reach died here in 1856. He was a journalist and novelist, and a close friend of Shirley Brooks.
